task: Review RSP-27 config contract compatibility implementation.
user_intent: Norven requires RedCap to prevent project-level .redcap configs, hook-related config, contracts, and runtime state from silently drifting across versions. Unknown versions and unknown fields must not pass silently; old versions must be migrated with dry-run, backup, and receipt or explicitly rejected.
main_claim: RSP-27 is implemented within its own scope because RedCap now has a config compatibility contract, a config compat-check command, a config migrate command with dry-run/apply, schema_version written to RedCap-owned install.json and install-manifest.json, unknown-version and unknown-field negative probes, and aggregate check wiring.
changed_reality: Updated runtime/core/project_install.py to write schema_version to install-manifest.json and install.json, and audit install-manifest schema_version.

evidence.summary: RSP-27 config compatibility contract with matrix, migration rules, host-owned exceptions, and acceptance criteria.
Project installation now writes and audits schema_version for RedCap-owned generated configs.
Command entry for config compat-check, migrate, self-check.
Current RSP-27 positive and negative acceptance evidence.
Scoped RSP-27 completion claim excluding RedCap parent completion.
RSP contract check receipt for scoped claim.

known_constraints: Do not claim RedCap 完整复活.
Check whether RedCap-owned configs get schema_version without corrupting host-owned Codex config formats.
Check whether unknown schema_version and unknown fields are rejected, not silently ignored.
Check whether migration requires dry-run and apply creates backup and receipt.
Concern or block findings must identify a concrete minimum fix.
